svg.title: Boot sequence: Aditya Meena developer profile with radar, live load, fact ticker and endless runner game

g.text: Python is named after Monty Python, not the snake. ◆ The famous first computer 'bug' was a real moth (1947). ◆ Bitcoin's genesis block was mined on 3 January 2009. ◆ Solidity was first proposed in 2014 by Gavin Wood. ◆ The Internet Computer mainnet went live in May 2021. ◆ FER2013 holds roughly 35,000 grayscale 48x48 face images. ◆ Ada Lovelace published the first machine algorithm in 1843. ◆ OpenCV started life at Intel in 1999. ◆ TensorFlow was open-sourced by Google in 2015. ◆ Hardhat runs a local Ethereum network for testing contracts. ◆

Python is named after Monty Python, not the snake. ◆ The famous first computer 'bug' was a real moth (1947). ◆ Bitcoin's genesis block was mined on 3 January 2009. ◆ Solidity was first proposed in 2014 by Gavin Wood. ◆ The Internet Computer mainnet went live in May 2021. ◆ FER2013 holds roughly 35,000 grayscale 48x48 face images. ◆ Ada Lovelace published the first machine algorithm in 1843. ◆ OpenCV started life at Intel in 1999. ◆ TensorFlow was open-sourced by Google in 2015. ◆ Hardhat runs a local Ethereum network for testing contracts. ◆
